key_idea: At most 15 distinct Pokemon, so do a TSP-style DP over the set of caught species with the last visited stop as state.
sketch: dp[mask][i] = shortest Manhattan route from the origin that has caught species set mask and ends at stop i. Transition to any stop j whose species is not in mask. Answer is min over i of dp[full][i] plus the distance back to the origin. Complexity O(2^15 * n^2) with n <= 20, about 13M operations. Pitfalls: map names to species ids, several stops can share a location (distance 0) and a stop catches only its own listed Pokemon, and the return trip to the start must be added.
